summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 8, 2026, reporting the consolidated form of director and related-party transactions as per CVM resolution 44/21. The filing details shareholdings of board members, executive management, fiscal council, and controlling shareholders, including opening and closing balances for common registered shares. No transaction prices, deal terms, premiums, or pending special-situation events are provided. This is a routine disclosure of insider holdings and derivative positions, not a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring. No action item or close date is identifiable.
